title: AEIB v0.4.1: Execution-Integrity Reference Software and Test Harness
description:
AEIB v0.4.1 is an open-source reference execution-integrity boundary and test harness for state-mutating AI agent actions. Under the stated evaluation model, it evaluates pre-dispatch standing checks immediately before network dispatch, computes candidate action IDs using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization, latches transport uncertainty (fail-closed EFFECT_INDETERMINATE logic), suppresses speculative retries, and provides single-flight target reconciliation probes.

License: Apache-2.0. Specification and evidence documentation artifacts are deposited under CC-BY-4.0 in the companion deposition record.
notes: Cryptographic digests (SHA-256) of archive artifacts are attached as sibling files. Offline verifier performance metrics represent tested outcomes in configured local environments; independent reproduction is pending.
